product.description: Experience a 7-hour, fully narrated tour onboard luxury tour buses. This tour offers 4 convenient  1-hour stops at Santa Monica Pier, Farmer's Market, Griffith Observatory and the Walk of Fame. See the Hollywood Sign, Beverly Hills, Rodeo Drive, Sunset Strip, movie locations and more.

itineraryItems.description: Take a walk down the Pier. See beautiful views of the Pacific Ocean and visit 3rd St. Promenade.
Enjoy some of the best food in LA and food from different cultures. Do some shopping at The Grove.
See the Hollywood Sign and views of Downtown LA. Enjoy space and science exhibits.
See the Grauman's Chinese Theatre. Experience Dolby Theatre (home of the Oscars.) Take a photo with your favorite Celebrity Star.
